title: Move begin_guard_deadline next to Begin's call bound in engram_begin_replay.rs
outcome: EngramBindingTarget::begin_guard_deadline lives in src/engram_begin_replay.rs beside begin_rpc_timeout_until (whose module keeps Begin's call bound out of the large adapter file), and that module's ownership header names it; engram_host_adapter.rs only calls it.
acceptance: Move begin_guard_deadline next to Begin's call bound in engram_begin_replay.rs is done
